languageVersion.description: The language version of this runtime (ex. "3.9").

sourcePackage.description: The C3 package where this runtime is seeded.

language.description: The language, including version, of this runtime (ex. "Python 3.9").

parents.description: The names of the parents of this runtime.

packages.description: Details about the declared packages of this runtime.

dependencies.description: Details about the dependency packages of this runtime.

repositories.description: The names of the repositories for this runtime, in search order.

parentRepositories.description: The names of the repositories used by the parents of this runtime.

declaredResolvedPackages.description: The resolutions of the declared packages of this runtime.

inheritedResolvedPackages.description: The resolutions of the inherited packages of this runtime.

inheritedDeclaredPackages.description:
A map from package names declared by this runtime's ancestors to a comma-separated
string of the package version in the declarations.

lastResolvedTime.description: When the runtime was most recently resolved.

title:
Runtime information for each runtime successfully returned by {@link Jupyter.RuntimeInfo.listRuntimeDetails}.
It is intended to be used by Jupyter UI, so it will contain some redundant information (with itself and
with the corresponding {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime}) that we want to avoid computing on the front end.
name: Jupyter.RuntimeDetails
